title: Beast Form
text: “Really? By my standards, I think it looks fine.”
“Don’t mess with me! You’re just trying to make a fool of me by making me wear that, aren’t you?”
My father silently approached the Panda Beastman, reached out, and touched its shoulder. It seems he’s checking its fur and such.
“Oh, it’s coarser than I thought. If you wash it regularly with soap and use fabric softener… do you even have any?　If you soften the fur, wouldn’t that bring it closer to the image?”
“What the hell are you talking about, you bastard!”
“I’m just saying that cute clothes would look fancier and suit you better than that bulky armor.”
There was a weird “pfft” sound, and the Panda beastman took a few steps back. Since he’s a Beastman, it’s hard to tell much from his facial expressions. But he seems pretty flustered.
“Hahaha, I’m telling you to cut the crap already!”
“That’s right! What do you think you’re doing to Big Sis?!”
The panda beastman’s underlings—who looked like a bunch of thugs—started making a commotion.
“Maybe a ‘crowd-pleaser panda’? I figured if we used your species’ good looks for business instead of hiring mercenaries, you’d probably become popular.”
“Are you trying to turn me into some kind of sideshow?!”
“I don’t know if you’re a rare species or not, though.”
The panda beastman turned around as if giving up and started walking back toward his minions. I suppose you could say he was disillusioned? My Father ran after him and placed a ribbon on his head.
“What are you doing?!”
“I was just wondering if it would look good on you.”
“It doesn’t look good!”
“What do you think?”

I have absolutely no idea. Does a ribbon really look good on a Panda? He should just go play with tires. Her subordinates seem to have a strange expression on their faces—neither anger nor exasperation.
“Surprisingly?”
“Nah, isn’t it just that ‘contrast’ thing?”
“She’s got a tough-guy face, so if she wears women’s stuff, it might actually suit her.”
The Panda Beastman glared at her subordinates as if they were a nuisance. Her subordinates looked away awkwardly under her glare. Eventually, with a sigh, the Panda beastwoman addressed her Father.
“Sigh… My bad. What were you guys doing?”
“Well, we’re looking for a Beastman who can teach Keel how to transform. Since you’re a mercenary, do you know anyone like that?”
“What? You don’t know how to transform? Where on earth are you guys from?”
“…Melromarc.”
“Isn’t that the country most notorious for discriminating against Demi-Humans…? I see. No wonder I thought you were a Demi-Human with a strange language.”
The panda beastman walked over toward Keel.
“All right, I’ll show you what transformation looks like in practice, so watch closely.”
With that, the panda beastman transformed into a pig. Father watched the scene with a look of surprise and let out a gasp. I wonder if something crossed his mind?
“Hey, hey. Why don’t you try dressing up in something really cute? I’m sure it’ll look great on you.”
“Oink!”

The panda beastman, now transformed into a pig, punched my father in law in the face and hurt his hand. It’s pointless to punch the Shield Hero’s father in law. However, from the moment he turned into a pig, I couldn’t understand a word he was saying.
“I promise you won’t laugh at me! I’m not joking!”
“Boo-boo!”
She struck her Father again with her free hand. But since it had no effect, she let out a frustrated groan and transformed back into a Panda Beastman.
“You better cut it out already! There’s no way I’m going to dress like this!”
So, she grabbed Father’s shoulder with all her might and tried to lift him up, but Father’s enhanced state prevented him from moving.
“Boo-boo-boo!”
“Shut up! It’s because your buddy keeps saying unnecessary things!”
“Big Sis is right! Go for it!”
“You lot, back off! I’ll make you pay with your own bodies for the sin of teasing me!”
“I won’t let you.”
Sakura-chan steps forward to protect Father.
“It’s okay, Sakura-chan. It’s fine, so Motoyasu-kun, just stay still, okay?”
“You really think you can push me around!”
She’s trying to give my father a bear hug, but it doesn’t seem to be working out.
“Damn it! This guy’s so stiff!”
“Are you done? Well, then, I think I’ll have a little fun with you too.”
My father took a piece of cloth from his shield and wrapped it around the Panda Beastman’s neck. It looks just like a scarf. Then he tried wrapping another one around its head.
“Whoa! Don’t mess with me!”
The Panda Beastman broke free from the bear hug and, looking annoyed, pulled off the scarves that Father had put on it.
“I told you to cut it out already!”
“I’m not messing around either, you know? Actually, men’s clothes don’t suit you at all.”
“Sigh… I guess I lose. So don’t try to make me wear silly outfits like that.”
Saying that, the Panda Beastman stuffed the cloth that his Father had given her into her pocket. That’s definitely a foreshadowing moment. Just as I’d expect from his Father!

Then, she transformed back into a pig and began teaching Keel something. Eventually, she placed her hand on Keel’s head and began chanting Magic. After a gentle, magical sensation, Keel began to transform—into the familiar form of a puppy.
“Yay! I finally managed to transform, big bro!”
“Way to go, Keel!”
“What do you think? Do I look cool?”
“If I had to choose, I’d say you’re more on the cute side.”
“Ehh! There’s no way that’s true! You’re a cool big sis.”
The panda beastman is staring at Keel with a somewhat skeptical look.
“Hey, hey! How do I become as cool as you, sis? Tell me!”
“Uh, yeah. Well, to become like me, you shouldn’t wear fluttery skirts or anything like that…”
As she says this, the panda beastman is staring intently at Keel’s clothes, which fell off during the transformation.
“Just put on some armor and join the battle!”
“Oh, I see! I’ll do my best!”
“Motoyasu, can you understand what Keel is saying?”
“I understand now. He’s finally gone back from being a pig to being a dog.”
“From a pig to a dog… so that’s how you see it…”
“Yay! I’ve finally become a man!”
Keel is striking a victory pose, but his Father looks a bit exasperated.
“Keel. Just because Motoyasu-kun recognizes you doesn’t mean you’re not a woman anymore.”
“Whaaaaaat!?”
“…You guys are a funny bunch. How about it? Want to go hunt some monsters?”
The panda beastman seems to be in a better mood now and is inviting my Father on a hunt.
“Well… I guess I could go, as long as it’s before nightfall.”
“Got it. Well then, let’s head out for a bit!”
My Father has agreed as well. After all, this is a hunt limited to Siltvelt. I’ve had my own experience with MMOs, you know. Isn’t it great to go monster hunting with the folks you’ve met there?
“I’ve got something to do, so I’m heading somewhere else with Kou.”
“Oh? Well then, let’s go. Sakura-chan”
“Yeah!”
Bofun and Sakura-chan transformed into their Filolial-sama forms, leaving the Panda Beastman and his subordinates speechless with surprise.
“Come on, let’s go. Let’s head to my recommended hunting spot before the sun sets and take down some monsters.”
“Ah, uh…”
“Oh, right. I should ask your name, shouldn’t I? My name is Naofumi.”
“Me? My name is Larsazusa, but my close friends just call me Rasa.”
“Nice to meet you, Rasa.”
“Yeah, nice to meet you too, Naofumi.”
My father and the panda beastman hit it off right away and set off on their hunt. Until they left, Keel kept asking me insistently, “Do you understand what they’re saying?” and I nodded every time.
